summary: Rechecked only the nine requested estimates and audited outcome coverage. Read the complete markdown conversion, including the Reporting Summary, and all ten pages of the main PDF. Also checked Lee and Chung (2024), PDF pp. 6-8, for the inherited randomized designs, assistance conditions and factorial arms. No new numerical or coding discrepancy was established in the nine targeted records. The corrected category_count code fits the count of unique concepts; question=across_people, construct=diversity, unit=set, higher_is=more_diverse, AI availability, immediate timing, between-person design and comparison codes agree with the sources. The nine recorded 95% CI levels are printed in the Fig. 1 caption; S3 control_mean=100 is printed as 100% for the human pool and is correctly expressed in percent units. All analysis-specific participant counts remain null; the available reanalysis does not print those people counts. Figure-only arm values remain null under extraction rule 1. No numerical contrast uncertainty or its sampling basis could be verified from the available text; se_basis=not_reported must not be taken as confirmation that the unavailable supplement reports no uncertainty. Five in-scope supplementary outcome families remain missing despite being acknowledged in not_extracted/open_items. Publisher and OSF requests failed with WinError 10013, and targeted local filename searches found no supplement. Full supplementary contrast coverage, including any AI-configuration comparisons, therefore remains unverified. The five problem entries count missing outcome families, not an inferred number of pairwise estimates.
